title: Ben Yue Fu Yan

alternative_titles.en: Flying to the Moon and Banquet

synopsis:
Sparkly Key Animation Studio presents its brand new 2023 Lunar New Year short film, "Flying to the Moon and Banquet"!

The tiger, with its majestic power, bids farewell to the old year; the rabbit, with its auspicious omens, celebrates the new spring!

The Qin Heavenly Martial Arts Battle swallows the sun and moon; the Celestial Master's Ghostly Decree rides the wind and clouds!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
